title: Concept: Set-Cookie attribute name is misspelt so the browser ignores it
description: Cookie attribute names are matched exactly, so Http-Only, http_only, Same-Site and Seccure are inert text. The header then looks protected in a code review and in a header dump while the browser enforces nothing, which is worse than an obviously missing attribute because no reviewer looks twice at a header that appears to carry it.
applicability: Responses that set cookies through the header.
risk: The cookie is stored without the protection the author intended: without HttpOnly it is readable from script, without Secure it travels on plaintext requests, and a broken SameSite allows cross-site sends.
